name: DHEM-AP particle energy flux, category 2 (compound)
cond_layout: SML[0:24]+SMU[24:48] (24 MLT-sector SML and SMU, assets/conditions_joint_9_zscore_stats_SMU_SML.npz) + Tilt[48] + SYMH[49] + SML_mean_30m[50] + SML_mean_120m[51] (assets/conditions_joint_9_zscore_stats_SMU_SML_tilt_symh_hist.npz) + dSML_filt_dt[52:53] (assets/conditions_4cat_zscore_stats.npz)
category_definition: Forsyth et al. (2015) SOPHIE substorm phases: 1 growth, 2 compound, 3 isolated, 4 convection; each minute is generated by the model of its category

training.recipe: 52-d backbone (tsh_mlat) 390k -> category 2 fine-tune, uniform loss, +20k = 410k -> cross-attention added + Eq. 4 oval-weighted loss, +20k; checkpoint 430k (train_4cat_ovxM_cat2.slurm)

loss.type: hybrid (learn_sigma) MSE + VLB; pixel weights of Eq. 4 in the final stage
loss.hp_gate_note: weighting off below 10 GW, linear ramp to full weight at 20 GW
loss.mask: k-means auroral-oval boundaries of every training map, assets/oval_boundaries_training.npz (scripts/data_prep/compute_oval_boundaries.py)

architecture.cross_attention: MLT cross-attention in all 11 attention blocks: keys / values = the 24 SML/SMU sector tokens, queries = pixels, learnable relative-MLT bias, 4 heads, zero-initialised output projection

notes: Trained with num_heads_upsample = 1; the paper results use the output-block self-attention with 4 heads (same weights), as set here. Raw weights, not EMA.
selection: the last six checkpoints (5,000 steps apart) of the final stage were compared on the 2003 validation dataset (odd 10-day blocks, scripts/split2003.py); highest HP correlation with AMIE kept. Paper statistics: 2003 test dataset (even blocks).
